title: SpecAliveStructuredSystemModel
description: Structured Intermediate Representation (IR) for engineering system models. Serves as the single source of truth for both SysML v2 and Modelica generation.

system_name.description: Identifier for the engineering system model (alphanumeric with underscores, valid across SysML and Modelica).

description.description: Human-readable summary of the system architecture, function, and purpose.

source_references.description: Citations or textual excerpts from the original engineering specification providing evidence for the model.

assumptions.description: Explicit engineering assumptions made during extraction (e.g., component simplifications, ideal behavior, default parameters). Never fabricate unrecorded physics.

missing_information.description: Genuinely unknown, ambiguous, or unstated specifications from the natural-language input that are needed for full modeling or simulation.

parameters.description: Global or system-level parameters (e.g., ambient conditions, supply limits).

states.description: Operational, supervisory, or discrete behavioral states of the system.

transitions.description: State transitions linking system operational states.

components.description: Physical, electrical, mechanical, or logical components comprising the system.

id.description: Unique component instance identifier within the system.

type.description: Component classification or domain type (e.g., Resistor, DC_Motor, Inertia, Switch).

library_reference.description: Standard library component reference (e.g., Modelica Standard Library path or SysML v2 standard part def).

description.description: Description of component role or function.

source_reference.description: Specification quote or section from which this component was derived.

parameters.description: Physical parameters belonging to this component.

ports.description: Interaction interface points (electrical pins, mechanical flanges, fluid ports, signal ports).

connections.description: Topological connections linking component ports (representing physical interactions or signal flows).

source_port.description: Fully qualified ID of the source port (<component_id>.<port_name>).

target_port.description: Fully qualified ID of the target port (<component_id>.<port_name>).

domain.description: Physical interaction domain (e.g., electrical, mechanical_rotational, signal).

description.description: Engineering rationale or description of the connection.

name.description: Parameter symbol or identifier (e.g., R, J, V_nom, k).

value.description: Explicit parameter value, symbolic expression, or null if genuinely unknown.

unit.description: Engineering unit (e.g., Ohm, V, s, rad/s, kg.m2, N.m/A).

description.description: Functional description or context of the parameter.

source_reference.description: Specification quote or source reference justifying the value.

is_assumption.description: True if this value is an assumed or estimated engineering quantity rather than directly stated.

uncertainty.description: Tolerance, confidence range, or explicit uncertainty description (e.g., '+/- 5%', 'unverified estimate').

name.description: Local port name (e.g., p, n, flange_a, flange_b, in, out).

port_type.description: Port classification (e.g., electrical_pin, mechanical_rotational_flange, mechanical_translational_flange, fluid_port, signal_input, signal_output, thermal_port).

domain.description: Physical domain (electrical, rotational_mechanics, translational_mechanics, thermal, fluid, control).

direction.description: Flow direction for signal ports or conservative interface direction.

description.description: Interface notes or physical port characteristics.

id.description: Unique state identifier (e.g., OFF, STARTING, RUNNING, FAULTED).

is_initial.description: Indicates whether this state is the initial operational state.

description.description: Behavior or mode characteristics in this state.

trigger.description: Event or input condition triggering the transition.

guard.description: Boolean condition that must be satisfied for transition.

action.description: Actions or state variable assignments executed during transition.
